subject: New gatekeepers joining — need to shift demo cadence
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@starlitehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Starlite: request to expand demo audience (security + procurement)

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team found the performance numbers compelling. Quick update from our side: leadership has asked that we include Security (CISO office), Platform, and Procurement on the next session so they can sign off on integration and contractual controls.

A few constraints to flag: our CISO (Olivia Park) is traveling July 26–27, and Procurement has a calendar freeze mid-day on the 25th for internal review. Given those conflicts, we need to move the demo out of the current slot.

Would it be possible to either:
- split the session into two focused blocks (technical deep dive + governance/procurement review) OR
- shift to the afternoon of Friday the 28th (PST) when most key folks are available?

I can loop in procurement directly if that helps. Attached is a short procurement checklist we use.

Best,
Amelia Torres
Head of Partnerships — Starlite Health
attachments: Procurement_Checklist_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite: request to expand demo audience (security + procurement)

Hi Amelia — really appreciate the heads-up.

We can absolutely accommodate the additional reviewers. Two proposals so we can align on what's least disruptive:

Option A — Single extended session (90 minutes): 45m product/tech + 30m security & governance + 15m procurement and next steps.
Option B — Two focused sessions: 1) Technical deep dive (45m) with Platform + Eng; 2) Governance & procurement (30m) with Security + Legal. We can run them back-to-back or on separate days.

If Procurement prefers a narrower session, splitting usually helps them focus on contractual checkpoints and SLAs without the product Q&A overlap. Vivek, can you draft a concise agenda for the governance block (KV caching, data residency, audit logs, KMS/HSM integration) and attach it?

Marissa — can you propose 3 slots after July 28th that work for our team? Friday afternoon PST is likely OK but let's get hard availability.

Thanks — Michael

--
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@starlitehealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Amelia Torres <amelia@starlitehealth.com>
Cc: Starlite Procurement <procurement@starlitehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite: request to expand demo audience (security + procurement)

Thanks, Michael.

Procurement is on board to join but they'd prefer the split approach — separate contract & SLA review so they can circulate the ask internally. Also our VP of Security (Olivia Park) will be back on site on the 28th afternoon, so Friday the 28th PST works best if we do back-to-back sessions.

Please note: Procurement will want the draft SLA matrix and retention details ahead of the meeting (even a spreadsheet is fine). Circling in procurement@starlitehealth.com.

Carlos
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Starlite Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite: request to expand demo audience (security + procurement)

Adding the governance agenda and a proposed two-slot plan (attached). Highlights included:
- Technical session (45m): Runtime architecture, batching/caching demo, kernel selection summary, integration checklist.
- Governance session (40m): Data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2 evidence flow, contract SLOs.

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf; Procurement_Qs.xlsx

I've tentatively blocked:
- Fri Jul 28, 13:00–13:45 PST — Technical deep dive (Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tech123)
- Fri Jul 28, 14:00–14:40 PST — Governance & Procurement follow-up (Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=gov456)

If those times look good, Marissa can send formal invites to all stakeholders. If you need the sessions on separate days, say so and we'll free up options.

Neha, can you include SOC2 evidence retention notes (one-pager) before end of day?

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@starlitehealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@starlitehealth.com>

Thanks everyone — confirmed.

I've sent two calendar invites (attached links below) for the back-to-back sessions on Fri Jul 28 PST:
- Technical deep dive — 13:00–13:45 PST (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tech123)
- Governance & procurement — 14:00–14:40 PST (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=gov456)

Attachments included here: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf; Procurement_Qs.xlsx; SLA_Matrix_draft.xlsx
